{{Top|leg}}
'''Metacycline''' was a medicine used to lessen the effects of the [[sickness]] suffered by the members of the [[Community]] from the [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]]. It included a mixture of a [[genetic coherence sequencer]], an [[antipsychotic]], and a [[blood thinner]].
